buttons.label: Bump Major Version
buttons.command: cd "${CWD}" && f=engine/Cargo.toml && cur=$(sed -n 's/^version = "\(.*\)"/\1/p' "$f" | head -1) && IFS=. read -r maj min pat <<< "$cur" && new="$((maj+1)).0.0" && sed -i '' "s/^version = \"$cur\"/version = \"$new\"/" "$f" && echo "Bumped $cur -> $new"

buttons.label: Bump Minor Version
buttons.command: cd "${CWD}" && f=engine/Cargo.toml && cur=$(sed -n 's/^version = "\(.*\)"/\1/p' "$f" | head -1) && IFS=. read -r maj min pat <<< "$cur" && new="$maj.$((min+1)).0" && sed -i '' "s/^version = \"$cur\"/version = \"$new\"/" "$f" && echo "Bumped $cur -> $new"

buttons.label: Bump Bug Fix Version
buttons.command: cd "${CWD}" && f=engine/Cargo.toml && cur=$(sed -n 's/^version = "\(.*\)"/\1/p' "$f" | head -1) && IFS=. read -r maj min pat <<< "$cur" && new="$maj.$min.$((pat+1))" && sed -i '' "s/^version = \"$cur\"/version = \"$new\"/" "$f" && echo "Bumped $cur -> $new"
